reviews.text: Risk of Rain 2-like Armored Core VI Demake. The V10 playtest omni-movement turbo-boost feels so buttery it's worth the play on that alone. Demo available.
ZAMN, I never knew Armored Core at home could be so 𝘨𝘰𝘰𝘥. You definitely want to keep an eye on this one, trust me.

For a game piloting a mech, there is a lot this game gets right. To the movement and guns to the customization and personalization of your own mech. I overall found myself enjoying the game's playtest
